high-school-graduation.finding: a higher probability of high-school graduation

context.all: These are reform-based model estimates for the sampled 1955–1985 birth cohorts, not randomized trial effects.
context.low-income: This group had parental family income below twice the poverty line in at least one childhood year.
context.nonpoor: This group never had parental family income below twice the poverty line during measured childhood.

policy: State a proposition in the title; keep source coefficients on their original scale. Unmarked nonpoor estimates must not become claims of established effects or proof of no effect. No new percentage, cost-effectiveness or benefit-cost calculation.
